application.question: What drove NVIDIA's full-year revenue growth in FY2026?
application.answer:
- NVIDIA’s FY2026 revenue rose 65% to $215.9 billion for the year ended January 25, 2026, primarily driven by accelerated computing and AI demand. Data Center revenue grew 68%. [S7][S9]
- Blackwell was the central product driver: Data Center computing revenue grew 59% on demand for the Blackwell platform. Networking revenue grew 142%, driven by the NVLink compute fabric ramp for GB200 and GB300 systems, plus growth in Ethernet and InfiniBand platforms. [S8][S10]
- Other businesses also contributed: Gaming revenue grew 41% on strong Blackwell demand; Professional Visualization grew 70% on Blackwell demand and the DGX Spark launch; Automotive grew 39% through continued adoption of NVIDIA’s self-driving platforms. [S7]
